  • Constructor Details

    • TurnOrderTrack

      public TurnOrderTrack(int[] slots)
      Constructs a TurnOrderTrack with the given slots. Each slot in the array represents the effect of that position (for example, the amount of food a player gains or pays when occupying it). Initially, all positions are empty (null), meaning no player occupies any slot.
      Parameters:
      slots - an array of integers representing the effect of each slot

  • Method Details

    • setPlayerAt

      public void setPlayerAt(int index, Player p)
      Places the given player in the specified slot and applies the slot's effect. The effect of the slot is determined by the value in the slots array at the given index: - If the value is positive, the player gains that amount of food - If the value is negative, the player pays that amount of food After applying the effect, the player is recorded in the positions list at the same index, marking the slot as occupied.
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the slot where the player will be placed
      p - the player to occupy the slot
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is invalid

    • getFirstFreeSlot

      public int getFirstFreeSlot()
      Returns the index of the first free slot in the track.
      Returns:
      the index of the first free slot, or -1 if there are no slot available

    • resetOrder

      public void resetOrder()
      Resets the turn order track by clearing all player positions.

      After calling this method, all slots in the track will be set to null, making them available for a new turn order assignment. Typically used at the end of a round before assigning players to new positions.

    • removePlayer

      public void removePlayer(Player p)
      Removes the given player from the track, freeing their slot.

      Used when a player places their token on an offer tile and must therefore vacate their current position in the turn order track. Only the slot belonging to p is cleared; all other positions remain unchanged.

      Parameters:
      p - the Player to remove from the track

    • placeWithoutEffects

      public void placeWithoutEffects(int index, Player p)
      Places the given player in the specified slot WITHOUT applying the slot's food effect.

      Used for administrative re-insertions into the track that are not the result of a real game action — for example, when a disconnected player's turn is force-skipped during PLACING_TOTEMS (see PlacingState.forceSkipCurrentPlayer). In that situation the player never occupied an offer tile, so there is no "return from the tile" event to justify granting or charging food; using setPlayerAt(int, Player) there would fabricate a food effect the rules do not prescribe.

      Parameters:
      index - the index of the slot where the player will be placed
      p - the player to occupy the slot
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the slot is already occupied

    • setEffectsActive

      public void setEffectsActive(boolean active)
      Enables or disables the application of slot effects when players are placed.

      Effects are inactive by default and should be enabled by calling setEffectsActive(true) once the game has started, so that pre-game token placement does not trigger food bonuses or penalties.

      Parameters:
      active - true to enable slot effects; false to disable them
